errorCodes.meaning: The credential's `credentialSubject.id` is not this community's DID.
The sender is not an active member of this community.
The credential does not verify, or is not a MembershipCredential.
`requestId` was supplied but no join request with that id exists.
`requestId` names a join request that is not in the approved state, so there is nothing to reciprocate.
`requestId` names a join request whose applicant is not the delivering member.

requestId.description: Optional: an approved join request this delivery also closes. When present and naming an approved request whose applicant is the delivering member, the community records the delivered credential as the reciprocal half of the join and marks the request's reciprocation complete.
